source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_documented.habit: Shrub or small tree to 13 m, with short trunk and numerous long arching intertwined branches
morphology_documented.leaves: Evergreen alternate odd-pinnate compound leaves; 3–11 sessile oblong to elliptic leaflets 2.5–5 cm long, usually toothed; reddish often winged petiole; aromatic resinous crushed foliage
morphology_documented.flowers: Dioecious; small white 5-petaled flowers about 2 mm across in axillary panicles
morphology_documented.fruit: Globose drupe approximately 6 mm across, green becoming red
